rationale: Record a ctest label added in test/cmake/view_widget_bridge_tests.cmake under visual-proof-harness: inspector-stripped-artifact-runs now carries the `commit-bound` label, because its executable's inspector marker source holds a per-configure build nonce and its bytes change on every configure of an identical tree. The label routes nothing; it is the declaration a test-reuse policy reads to rebuild and rerun the test every time. No test body, detector, threshold, fixture, proof artifact or harness behaviour changes. Registered as watch-only so family coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
